title: On AI Coding and Its Discontents
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: Back in January, I received a note from a senior software engineer in Silicon Valley. He described himself as an AI skep

The problem is that code produced by an AI agent *looks* reasonable, but can contain ‘hard-to-spot bugs’ that end up causing major problems. As a result, you should carefully review your agent’s output, but this is difficult.
